newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo in marketing alliance with Major League Baseball.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo in marketing alliance with Major League Baseball.

text.p: Pepsi-Cola Co., a unit of PepsiCo Inc., said Wednesday it entered a five-year marketing alliance with Major League Baseball, making Pepsi baseball's official soft drink and giving the company exclusive rights to use Major League Baseball's trademarks.
The soft drink giant said the alliance provides Pepsi exclusive rights to Major League Baseball's All-Star balloting effort, which the company will use in a nationwide promotion.
As part of the marketing partnership, Pepsi said it has made a "substantial commitment" to advertise on national television broadcasts of Major League Baseball games.
The company also said it will produce a series of "baseball themed" TV commercials to begin airing in the 1998 season.
